boundaries: Fixed24 all goals retained; failed/missing rounds remain unassessed in denominator, never omitted.
Prior four-case quick test and prior partial/old core-only data excluded.
Healthy denominator includes only independently completed, scored sessions; absent health evidence is unavailable, not invented zero.
Startup failures/no-fault attempts are metadata only and never extra cases or healthy denominators.
Healthy PROFILE conditional localization ratio is null when denominator0; separate from continuous monitor candidates.
Short24-step injection and8-10-step tail are limited checks, not population accuracy.
